page.overview:
Who is Carl Wisor?

Carl Wisor is a ninth-generation Ventrue spy for the Camarilla who possesses extensive knowledge about the inner workings of the Sabbat.

Born in 1709 as the son of a concerto pianist, Carl was Embraced in 1725. In the modern nights, he operated as a Camarilla spy, working undercover on the West Coast as a member of an Anarch gang. When his gang defected and joined the Sabbat, Carl chose to remain undercover within their ranks to gather intelligence. He operated within the sect for eight years, even rising to serve as his pack's priest. This position granted him highly specialized knowledge of Sabbat ritae, politics, ideology, and tactics.

His deep cover ended when a packmate discovered his true allegiance and revealed him as a spy. Carl managed to escape, but he is now hunted by the Sabbat because he knows too much. He is highly intelligent, cunning, and fully prepared for his pursuers. Expecting the Sabbat to come after him, he is ready to force his hunters to defend themselves against their own brutal methods, though he primarily wishes to be left in peace.

Image: Carl stands 5 feet 5 inches tall and weighs 158 pounds. When photographed in Los Angeles in 1981, Carl was short and stocky. He had long black hair and a mustache. Now he has medium-length, well-groomed blond hair. He almost always dresses entirely in black and habitually wears sunglasses.
